Fixed. The root cause: when an interval comes from a date diff (`diffAsCarbonInterval`), `CarbonInterval` caches `startDate`/`endDate`, and `total()` (src/Carbon/CarbonInterval.php:2585) short-circuits to `startDate->diffInUnit()`, ignoring any unit mutations.

The fix (src/Carbon/CarbonInterval.php) adds a `clearStartDateInterval()` helper that nulls the cached dates, called from every unit-mutating method: `set()` (all unit cases), `add()` (which backs `sub()`), `times()`, `multiply()`, and `weeksAndDays()` — so `totalSeconds` etc. are computed from the current unit values instead of the stale date diff.
